main.description: Deletes the community's spaces and its account. Members' own records stay in their own repos and simply become unreadable.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the community.delete permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView's stored credentials for this community are missing or unusable.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A PDS or third-party call the AppView depends on failed.
